Who I Am

Community is my
home base.

I've spent more than ten years building places where people feel heard. I started in the Riot Games support queues in 2013 and later ran Web3 communities across Discord, X and Reddit. The part that never changes is showing up. People stay in a community when they can tell someone is actually listening.

Along the way I built a Discord server from nothing to 80,000 members, helped run one with roughly 800,000, and led a team of seven Community Managers across three client accounts at once. I've also put together influencer programs that moved real numbers, not just the vibes.

I like working out why a community is thriving or struggling, and then doing the unglamorous work to fix it, without losing the human side that made people want to be there in the first place.

Career Path

Where I've
done the work.

March 2025 – Present
Pearl Abyss
Senior Community Manager, Latin America

I look after Black Desert Online's community across Latin America, from Discord and social channels to forums and in-game boards, in Portuguese, Spanish and English. A big part of my job is taking player concerns to the development team in Korea and bringing clear answers back.

When something goes wrong, I coordinate the regional response and keep players informed during LATAM hours. I also keep our moderators and regional partners on the same page about how we talk to players and handle issues, and share what players are saying with the global publishing team.

I'm rebuilding the LATAM creator and influencer program, too: finding the right people, working through contracts, setting content guidelines and tracking how their work performs.

Off The Clock

Things I build
just because.

I'm a gamer first, and I like shipping things. When a game is missing a tool I wish existed, I usually build it myself and keep polishing it until I'd actually want to use it.

caioklein.github.io/wog-idle-leper
Idle Loot Companion
Companion App · War of Genesis: Idle Loot (Steam)

I made this for an idle RPG I was playing on Steam. It has a database of 1,872 pieces of equipment, a DPS calculator that breaks down damage class by class, and a skill tree simulator that remembers your build. It even reads live data from the game's own engine over a websocket while you play. It's one HTML file, with nothing to install.

Vanilla JSWebSocket SyncTDD

caioklein.github.io/VGCHelper
VGC Helper
Reference Tool · Pokémon VGC

I built this one for myself first: a type-advantage and battle-planning tool for competitive Pokémon doubles. It has a full Pokédex, live competitive set data from Pikalytics, Mega Evolution toggles, and a Battle Box with an OHKO calculator, so I can stop doing damage math by hand mid-match.
